wensen en spijt uitdrukken met wish en if only

blocks.text: Voor iets dat in het verleden niet gebeurd is, en het denkbeeldige gevolg: if + past perfect, would have + voltooid deelwoord.

head: Engels
Werkelijkheid
rows: If I had studied, I would have passed.
Ik heb niet gestudeerd en ben gezakt.
If we hadn't missed the train, we wouldn't have been late.
We hebben de trein gemist.
She would have come if you had asked her.
Je hebt het niet gevraagd.
What would you have done if you had lost?
Je hebt niet verloren.

blocks.title: Als ik had ... had ik
blocks.text: Het Nederlands zegt Als ik het had geweten, was ik gekomen of zou ik gekomen zijn. Het Engels heeft een vaste vorm: If I had known, I would have come. Nooit If I would have known, en nooit I had come in de hoofdzin.

blocks.title: 'd = had of would
blocks.text: In de korte vorm If I'd known, I'd have come is de eerste 'd had en de tweede would. Na if staat altijd had.

head: Patroon
Voorbeeld
Betekenis
rows: verleden voorwaarde, gevolg nu
If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
ik nam de baan niet, ik ben niet rijk
voorwaarde nu, gevolg verleden
If I were braver, I would have said something.
ik ben niet dapper, ik zei niets

head: Wens over
Vorm en voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: nu (het is niet zo)
wish + past simple: I wish I had more time.
Had ik maar meer tijd.
het verleden (spijt)
wish + past perfect: I wish I hadn't said that.
Had ik dat maar niet gezegd.
gedrag van een ander (ergernis)
wish + would: I wish you would stop talking.
Hield je maar eens op met praten.
vermogen
wish + could: I wish I could swim.
Kon ik maar zwemmen.

blocks.title: Ik wou dat ... = I wish
blocks.text: Ik wou dat ik rijk was = I wish I were (was) rich. Het Engels gebruikt een tijd verder terug dan je verwacht: geen will, geen present. If only is sterker: If only I had listened! (Had ik maar geluisterd!)
4. it's time, I'd rather, as if

head: Uitdrukking
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: it's time + past simple
It's time we went home.
Het wordt tijd dat we naar huis gaan.
I'd rather + werkwoord
I'd rather stay in tonight.
Ik blijf vanavond liever thuis.
I'd rather + persoon + past
I'd rather you didn't smoke.
Ik heb liever dat je niet rookt.
as if / as though
He talks as if he knew everything.
Hij praat alsof hij alles weet.
If I would have known, I would have come.
If I had known, I would have come.
Na if: past perfect.
If she had asked, I had helped her.
If she had asked, I would have helped her.
In de hoofdzin: would have.
I wish I have more money.
I wish I had more money.
wish over nu: past simple.
I wish I didn't say that yesterday.
I wish I hadn't said that yesterday.
Spijt over het verleden: past perfect.
It's time we go home.
It's time we went home.
it's time + past simple.
I'd rather to stay here.
I'd rather stay here.
Na I'd rather geen to.
If I had taken the job, I would have been rich now.
If I had taken the job, I would be rich now.
Gevolg nu: would + werkwoord.

blocks.text: Vul de juiste vorm in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: If I ______ the answer, I would have told you.
items.full: If I had known the answer, I would have told you.

items.q: If we had left earlier, we ______ the train.
items.full: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

items.q: I wish I ______ to the party last night.
items.full: I wish I had gone to the party last night.

items.q: I wish you ______ stop interrupting me!
items.full: I wish you would stop interrupting me!
If only I could speak Chinese.
It's time you got a job.
I'd rather stay at home tonight.

items.q: If she had taken the medicine, she ______ better now.
items.full: If she had taken the medicine, she would feel better now.

items.q: He looks ______ if he hasn't slept for days.
items.full: He looks as if he hasn't slept for days.

items.q: Als ik het had geweten, was ik gekomen.
items.a: If I had known, I would have come.
I wish I had more time.

items.q: Had ik dat maar niet gezegd.
items.a: I wish I hadn't said that.

items.q: Het wordt tijd dat we naar huis gaan.
